svg.desc: 03 / The icons. Two models. Six languages. Out now. Llang Gap release featuring Fable 5.1 by Anthropic and GPT-6 Astra by OpenAI, in English, Russian, Kazakh, Chinese, French, and Portuguese. Black artwork on a white background. Prepared for publication on release day.
